QuestInfo.name: The Return of the Librarian
QuestInfo.0: Grendel the Really Old is finally back from his business. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Grendel the Really Old is finally back from his business. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.2: Grendel the Really Old says that it'll take time to gather info on Aurora.

0.0: Lolo told me about you. What do you want, kid?\r\n#L0##bI seek knowledge of Aurora.#l\n#k
0.1: Aurora? That's a name I haven't heard in a long time. It vanished centuries ago.\r\n#L0##bIf it still exists out there, I must find it.#l\n#k
0.2: Very well. Whatever your reasons, they must be important.

yes.0: To be honest, my memory isn't what it used to be. But I know this library better than anyone alive, so I can find what you're looking for.

no.0: You're free to look around. Let me know if you want any help.
